header.title: Latex Suite 1.13.1 context fixtures: where the caret is
header.howProduced: For every caret position of every document, the answer of the plugin's own Context (src/editor_context/context.ts: the mode flags, getBounds(), and the scope stack getEnvNames()) from Latex Suite 1.13.1 running headless in jsdom — the same harness as latex-suite-cases.json, with the same emulation of Obsidian's code-block and inline-code tests. `written` documents were chosen by hand to cover the Markdown and LaTeX constructs around math, and the shapes an `\end{…}` takes while its name is retyped; `random` ones were built from fragments of both (a fixed-seed generator). The bracket pairs come from the same run (`bracketPairs`).

format.runs: [from, to, mode, bounds, stack]: every caret position from `from` to `to` (inclusive, UTF-16) has this answer.
format.mode: The flags that are set, comma-joined: t text, n inline math, M display math, k math code block, c=<language> other closed code block, C inline code, T text macro inside math, S snippet-less macro inside math. Empty: none.
format.bounds: [outer_start, inner_start, inner_end, outer_end] of the equation the caret is in (getBounds()), or null. Written as null inside a non-math code block, where the plugin keeps the code block's bounds instead and no feature reads them.
format.stack: The scope stack, innermost first: command:<name>:<argument index>, environment:<name>, math.
format.equations: Present when the document has math: [caret, pairs] for each equation, where pairs are the bracket pairs auto-enlarge walks (highlight_brackets.ts pairBrackets) for the equation at that caret, each [open from, open to, close from, close to]. What an engine must agree on are the pairs auto-enlarge can rewrite: those whose opener is not `{`, `\(` or `\left…` and whose closer is not `\right…`. Among the others the plugin lists some pairs twice and stops a `\left.` opener before the dot, which changes nothing it writes.

divergent.reason: An unclosed `\begin{` followed by a character that cannot start an environment name, at the end of an unclosed math fence: lezer's error recovery makes an environment with an empty name that starts at `\begin` itself. Not reproduced; the engine reads the name group as an argument of `begin` (snippet-less).
